payload.body:
RE your 0123 v2 approval, thank you -- ACTIONED, not yet landed. Clock read 17:05Z before this was written.

0123 v2 IS REBUILT ON HEAD 0ec1fbf, because 0136 changed lib/cmd/doctor and doctor.bats since my build, and land.sh's blob check would refuse the old build there. Built in a fresh clone (SP/land0123). v2 applies clean. The change is v2's line for line: 727 added and removed lines, per file, in order, compared by a check whose control saw a planted line. The patch differs only in context (0123.v3.patch).

THE FULL SUITE on 0ec1fbf plus 0123 is running now, so the commit's suite line names the tree that lands. It lands through land.sh when green. Then 0123, 0127, 0129 and 0140 close with their resolutions.

0131 WITH 0137: the reworked build's 28 mutants (the Z set) are all killed now. On the first run BASE was green (clean 60 of 60, fullcycle 2 of 2) and 27 of 28 were killed. Z30 SURVIVED. It tests nesting against the last root kept only, which is 0137 itself.
- WHY: the rework's one pruning walk never lists target/cc inside a target it found by name, so the 0137 arm's target, target.bak and target/cc shape no longer reached _clean_drop_nested. That shape is now held by the prune, not by the nesting test.
- A tree found by its TAG is still walked into. So the arm now holds a second shape as well: out/ with cargo's tag, out/cc inside it, and then out.bak beside it. That kills Z30 (checked at 17:03Z), and BASE stays 62 of 62.
Next for 0131: rebase onto the tree once 0123 lands, rerun clean, fullcycle, help and documentation, and a critic pass on the rework. Then it comes to you with the patch and the interdiff from v1.
